text:
maria: kicked off a focused microbench sweep targeting dispatch heuristics on Ampere (seqlen/stride grid). results uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/execpath/1719998888/grid-sweep.csv

perf-bot: Nightly grid finished: scanned 180 kernel variants, flagged 12 regressions, 6 arch-sensitive changes. Median +0.6% latency vs baseline; Ampere p99 +5.7% on seqlen clusters 512/768 with odd stride patterns.

jon: which kernels correlate with the p99? any shared dispatch choices?

maria: jon: appears to be 'fused_attn_fast' chosen for some batch/stride combos, but inner microloop later falls back to scalar path. trace shows increased control-flow and cache thrash.

riya: my local reproducer showed this too — when KV cache stride % tile != 0, the fast tiled kernel misaligns and triggers a fallback. chat workload packing often produces batch sizes & strides like that.

sam: can you paste the trace? the harness should include per-call dispatch annotations.

jon: trace snippet:
```
dispatch_choice: fused_attn_fast
checked_tiles: 8, tile_size=32
kv_stride=41, batch=7 -> misalign -> select fused_attn_scalar
latency_ms: 1.28 -> 2.05
```

riya: ok that's convincing. proposal: change dispatch scoring to add an architecture-aware misalignment penalty on Ampere and add telemetry 'dispatch_miss' counter for fused paths. Also add a stride sweep to nightly harness (stride 0..127 for seqlen 128/512/768).

maria: +1. Also let's add a perf CI gating rule: block candidate promotion if p99 > baseline +5% for 3 consecutive nightly runs on any arch-sensitive cluster.

jon: drafting PR: quick heuristic: prefer fast tiled path only if (batch % tile == 0) || (seqlen <= 128) || (kv_stride % tile == 0). will iterate if telemetry shows false negatives.

sam: scheduling canary rollout for the dispatch tweak on two Ampere dedicated nodes for 48h. infra-bot will tag the deploy.

infra-bot: Canary deployed: canary/dispatch-stride-1719998888 -> nodes [ampere-canary-03, ampere-canary-04], start=1719999400, duration=172800

maria: filed PERF-1719 with links to PR, canary, and s3 artifacts. closing loop after 48h telemetry. thanks team :thumbsup:
